Name: Seed Starter Package
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14152]Custom Starter Package[/url] to replace the 15 parsnip seeds you get in a package at the start of new game with the following:

[list]
[*]5 Bean Starters
[*]5 Cauliflower Seeds
[*]5 Potato Seeds
[*]5 Garlic Seeds
[*]5 Kale Seeds
[*]5 Rhubarb Seeds
[*]5 Strawberry Seeds
[*]5 Rice Shoots
[*]5 Parsnip Seeds
[/list]

You can edit the content.json file if you want to change the amounts or types of seed.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
